instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction never names UF parent, map range, or size-rank as the bug.

discovery_budget.discovery: Printed hitch follows union-find parent, not the least token in the flattened component.
Pair files never union both tokens, so alias-only groups stay split.
rows.ndjson is emitted by ranging a map, so dump order is lost.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Hitch drift plus bookmark death; no UF wording.

attack_path.summary: Trace hitch drift versus green membership, ignore Rank, repair three loci, rebuild, sew.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Least hitch in component, join pair tokens, emit dump order, rebuild, sew.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Any one file leaves residual graded failures.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Residual work is diagnosis across hitch, pair, emit plus rebuild.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Size-rank and deskfold snapshot are decoy evidence.
